about: Photographs and documents the microsites (campus, sgacc, csr, legacy, campaign, careers) use, taken from PFA's own old site, which lives on at pf-acurrent.vercel.app (repository askrapidresponseteam-cloud/PFAcurrent) since peopleforanimalsindia.org became this site in Oct 2026. They are not in the release zip: DEPLOY.command copies media/site/ from the live tree when it has it, and scripts/fetch-site-photos.js fetches whatever is still missing (npm run media:site). Every frame that shows one turns into a plain plate with its caption if the file is not there, so a page never shows a broken image; scripts/audit-site.js and scripts/check-media.js accept a missing file only if it is listed here.
